'''Crystalsnail''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Jewelsnail]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "The spreading crystals have turned Crystalsnail's back into a shiny amethyst mine. No Tatari is alike, but Crystalsnail can't help but feel a surge of pride whenever catching a reflection by the water."

Crystalsnail is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Appearance ==
Crystalsnail's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form recolors the purple amethyst and accents on its shell into an emerald green color.
